text:
EXECUTIVE PRESENCE IS NOT ABOUT SPEAKING MORE.

It is about increasing the quality of your judgment when the room gets difficult.

Leadership presence is built through clarity, composure and consequence.

HIGH PERFORMERS DON'T ALWAYS GET PROMOTED.

Strong execution gets you noticed.

Strategic positioning gets you considered for the next level.

The question is not only:

How well am I performing?

It is also:

What level of leadership am I already demonstrating?

YOUR NEXT CAREER LEVEL REQUIRES A DIFFERENT VERSION OF YOU.

More responsibility does not automatically create executive leadership.

You have to expand your thinking before your role expands.
